_howTo: Edit freely. Trivia: the first answer in "a" is the correct one (the game shuffles them). Add "family": true to a trivia question to make it come up in every game, spread across the trivia rounds. "photos" lists family photos (file names in family-photos/, locked with encrypt-photos.mjs); they show at the reveal, or with the question if "showPhotos": "question". Fake fact: "___" marks the blank, "accept" lists other spellings of the real answer, "decoys" are house fakes used when there are few players. aboutYou prompts are what phones ask while people wait in the lobby.
